📋 WHAT WAS INSTALLED
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. React + TypeScript Standards
   • Component patterns and hooks
   • State management (Zustand + custom hooks)
   • Type safety best practices
   • Performance considerations

2. Testing Excellence (Vitest + React Testing Library)
   • Test structure and organization
   • Colocated test files (.test.tsx)
   • Mocking @capacitor/core and IndexedDB
   • Testing behavior, not implementation

3. TypeScript Mastery
   • Interface and type definitions
   • Discriminated unions for complex types
   • Generic patterns and constraints
   • Domain-specific type helpers

4. Accessibility Compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA)
   • Semantic HTML structure
   • ARIA attributes
   • Keyboard navigation
   • Color contrast standards

5. Performance Optimization
   • Code splitting with React.lazy()
   • Bundle size management
   • Runtime performance tuning
   • IndexedDB optimization

💡 QUICK START
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Step 1: Read the Documentation
   → Open: .github/README.md
   → Then: .github/COPILOT_SUMMARY.md
   → Reference: .github/COPILOT_WORKFLOWS.md

Step 2: Start Coding
   • Edit TypeScript/React files
   • Copilot automatically applies instructions
   • Ask specific questions for best results

Step 3: Example Prompts for Copilot
   ✓ "Create a new component for quiz configuration"
   ✓ "Write comprehensive tests for this service"
   ✓ "Add TypeScript types following our patterns"
   ✓ "Check this component for accessibility"
   ✓ "Optimize this for performance"

Step 4: Validate
   • Run tests: npm run test -- --run
   • Check build: npm run build
   • Review against COPILOT_WORKFLOWS.md

🎯 HOW TO USE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FOR DEVELOPERS
  1. Read .github/README.md for context
  2. Skim .github/COPILOT_WORKFLOWS.md for available workflows
  3. Ask Copilot: "Create component X following our patterns"
  4. Copilot will apply the instructions automatically

FOR CODE REVIEWERS
  1. Reference .github/COPILOT_WORKFLOWS.md as checklist
  2. Verify code follows React/TypeScript patterns
  3. Confirm tests are comprehensive (Vitest/RTL)
  4. Check accessibility and performance

FOR PROJECT MANAGERS
  1. Measure velocity with consistent patterns
  2. Track test coverage (target: >80%)
  3. Monitor bundle size (target: <500KB gzip)
  4. Validate accessibility (target: Lighthouse 95+)

🔧 TECHNICAL DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Technology Stack
├─ React 18 with TypeScript strict mode
├─ Vite for development & builds
├─ Vitest + React Testing Library
├─ Zustand for global state
├─ IndexedDB for persistence
├─ Capacitor for mobile support
└─ Single CSS file with CSS variables for theming

Project Structure
├─ src/hooks/               Custom state machines (useQuiz, useFlashcard, etc)
├─ src/services/            Business logic layer (quiz, storage, file handling)
├─ src/components/          Reusable UI components
├─ src/pages/               Page components (quiz, flashcard, summary)
├─ src/store/               Zustand global store
├─ src/types/               TypeScript type definitions
├─ .github/instructions/    Copilot customization files
└─ docs/                    Project documentation

Quality Gates
├─ Tests: npm run test -- --run (must pass all)
├─ Types: npx tsc --noEmit (must have zero errors)
├─ Build: npm run build (must produce bundle)
└─ Performance: npm run build (check dist/ size)

🌟 BEST PRACTICES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✓ Always run tests after changes: npm run test -- --run
✓ Reference examples in src/ when asking Copilot
✓ Be specific: "Like in src/hooks/useQuiz.ts, create..."
✓ Request tests alongside implementation
✓ Validate against COPILOT_WORKFLOWS.md before committing
✓ Keep instruction files updated as project evolves
